select

DATE_FORMAT(end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as timeLabel,
SUM(income) as income from w_order_position where order_no = #{orderNo} and end_time is not null group by timeLabel order by timeLabel asc

select
DATE_FORMAT(op.end_time, '%Y') as timeLabel,
DATE_FORMAT(op.end_time, '%Y-%m') as timeLabel,
DATE_FORMAT(op.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as timeLabel,
IFNULL(SUM(op.income), 0.0000) as totalProfit from w_order_position op inner join w_order_info o on o.order_no = op.order_no where o.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and op.end_time is not null
and op.end_time >= #{startTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and op.end_time <= #{endTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
group by YEAR(op.end_time)

order by timeLabel asc
